rules.rule: Builders run focused tests; builder results are implementation evidence only; validators issue verdicts (CX-PROOF-002). Depends on D1.
Table-driven tests run every case, collect failures, assert once listing all failing cases; no first-case panic.

Waves from root workspace.metadata.studio allowed edges: wave1 composite, controls, develop, interop-lrcat, interop-media, interop-psd, interop-vector, layout, motion, package, press, pulse, reel, render-cpu, render-gpu, score, web; wave2 components, interop-layout, motion-js, reel-native, score-device, score-plugin, session; wave3 harness, interop-fig, kernel-bindings.
Every lane (incl. Type) leaves its crate compile-green at the end of each turn; downstream builders treat upstream compile errors as wait-and-retry, never fix.
Stage only crates/hsk-studio-{crate}/; never git add -A / commit -a; never stage Cargo.lock or root Cargo.toml (steward-only).
Builder writes its Cargo.toml in one Write call; manifest errors in another lane are reported, not fixed.

Single lane-status source: builders/lanes/hsk-studio-{crate}.json {crate, foundation_mt, status, phase, commits, capabilities_done, tests{argv,exit,sha}, blockers[{error,file_line,attempts}], lock_wait_s, bg_pids, next, updated_at}; written at every commit and before any >2 min op. ledger.json is the lead index mirrored at tick.
At each lane verdict the lead appends one verdict to the lane's foundation MT JSON; other MT corpus entries untouched this session.

Continuous union rounds: start when >=1 lane READY and no round running; frozen SHA; persistent warm studio-round target refreshed in place; one reusable round script written in round 1; no per-verdict bespoke scripts; lock-stage-only failure = infrastructure, no status change.

Every brief <=5 KB with sections identity/edges, reuse APIs (verified), slice, >=1 independent oracle the builder may not edit, <=5 tests, non-goals, foundation MT ref; builders dispatched as each brief lands.
Oracles: spec numeric tables and PSD merged composite (check hasRealMergedData) before Adobe black-box exports; Adobe exports batched into one Operator-approved session; no lane gated on Adobe.
No gated hook phrases in commit messages, echo text or heredocs; write such text with the Write tool; on a hook block run the gameplan check and fix the failing step; never rephrase to dodge.
Use nextest with per-test slow-timeout/terminate-after once installed (CX-EXEC-005); record lock waits ('Blocking waiting for file lock') in lane file.
Deadlines: no pushed commit 30 min -> lead nudge; 45 min or same error twice -> fresh agent resumed from lane file; fresh agent per slice after its verdict.

Governance budget: governance writes only on lane status change, verdict or tick line; <=1 kernel commit per lead tick; no new governance file or gameplan step without a named observed failure; compiler/clippy errors never become gameplan steps; target kernel:product commits <=0.5 per interval.
Research agents end after their note; re-spawn on demand; a note not cited by a brief or diagnosis within 2 ticks is not refreshed.

Uncommitted edits in your crate are yours: compile; commit+push if green, else continue from lane.next. Do not touch other lanes' files. Update the lane file, then continue the loop.'

Lead restart checklist (add as DISPATCH_TEMPLATES topic 'lead-restart'): read team.json and lane files; report stale git index.lock in the product worktree's git dir and orphan cargo/rustc PIDs on D: (never stop them without PROCESS_STOP_APPROVED:<PIDs>); SendMessage-resume each running agent by agent_id with WF2-017; append one tick line; target <5 min restart-to-first-agent-output.
Never glob or full-read .GOV/task_packets/WP-KERNEL-STUDIO (6223 files, 1.3 GB); use explicit MT paths and JSON leaf selectors.
